about: An afternoon of a shared to-do list, as server took part in it: every event server was given, by its host or by a peer, in the order it took them, with what it held and what it sent its peers after each. Written by backends/rust/world/tests/a_world_run_is_what_every_backend_replays.rs from a run of the Rust machines (SCE_WORLD_SCENARIOS=write) and not by hand: the expected values are what the Rust engine did, which that test holds to oracles that read the network, and every other backend is held to them here.
